title: Concept: Audio loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: An audio element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The clip is fetched without transport protection, so the voice a customer hears during verification can be substituted on the path.
applicability: Deployments that render an audio element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The clip is fetched without transport protection, so the voice a customer hears during verification can be substituted on the path.
